clips.title: The story
paras: In western Wetlands, Bluegill Marsh is claimed by the hostile Bluegill tribe. Their huts and waterways are guarded by Gobbler, and travelers risk being surrounded in the shallows.

Bluegill murlocs crowd the muddy flats and reed beds of the western Wetlands. Their tribe has built crude camps in the stagnant water and claims the marsh as its own. They live and hunt in close-knit packs. Travelers and scouts from Menethil Harbor risk ambush from every direction when they wade into Bluegill territory, where the chieftain Gobbler prowls the shallows.
